title: Structure engineering
description: Grey-white paper and pure white panels with black ink, black-and-white inversion for every hover, and a single muted olive-gold band. A tight neo-grotesk for big quiet headings over a light grotesque mono for nav, labels and long body copy; nearly square corners, flat, hairline rules.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is an inverted sibling with the same olive-gold
primary is black (buttons, active states); highlight is the olive-gold band colour
secondary and card are pure white (nav pills, project cards) on a grey-white background
glow is the dark stone of photo placeholders under white type
radius 0.3rem: rounded-md ≈ 3px pills, rounded-lg ≈ 5px tags and cards
the gutter is 8px on phones and 24px from 1024px; the page column is 1300px including gutters
name: structureengineering-theme
